vdj.from_immune: Variable · Diversity · Joining — antibody gene segments recombine into one specificity
vdj.our_map: Distance · Direction · Disposition — chromatic segments recombine into one sort key
vdj.fuse: V -=+ D -=+ J → one specificity. incomplete triad = limp antibody / limp sort.

V_distance.measures: how far from violet midline (flank radius). how far green stance from collapse. how far brown from earth contact.
V_distance.units: flank steps from violet | legs lost (0–2) | DOWN gap
V_distance.already: rainbow-sort side distance; walker distance_inside; reportPrior distance from prior
V_distance.sort_role: magnitude. without V you know facing but not how far.

D_direction.measures: which way on the body — blue flank | violet middle | red flank | brown DOWN | green stance hold
D_direction.sign: on Klein, left/right flips at the fold; OPPOSITE flanks stay opposite
D_direction.already: chromatic-directionality axes; σ vs log; bend vs DOWN
D_direction.sort_role: heading. without D you have a length with no arrow.

J_disposition.measures: how the piece is seated to act — planted | ready | discharged | dead_gun | forgotten-with-weight | inferred-vs-reported
J_disposition.chekhov: disposition IS the join to discharge. shown→owed. mightier pen still needs J=write.
J_disposition.stance: green two legs joined under violet = disposed to stand
J_disposition.sort_role: readiness / joining. without J you have a vector that never fires.

triad_of_sorts.name: chromatic VDJ
triad_of_sorts.recombine: like VDJ — pick V segment, D segment, J segment → one epitope of color-sort
triad_of_sorts.refuse: sort on one letter only. that is a fragment, not an antibody.
